title: TikTok video #7675048440803511565
transcript: Hey, let's bake chocolate chip cookies but healthy. Oh boy. Hmm, insane. To a bowl, add one half cup oat flour, one scoop vanilla protein, two whole eggs, two tablespoons peanut butter, a drizzle of maple syrup, and mix into a thick batter. Now form this into cookies, topped with dark chocolate, bacon, and bang. Chocolate chip cookies made healthy.
